newsitem.title: LEBANON: Bomb explodes near Syrian intelligence centre.
newsitem.headline: Bomb explodes near Syrian intelligence centre.

text.p: A small bomb on Wednesday exploded near a centre for Syrian army intelligence in the northern Lebanese city of Tripoli, causing little damage but no casualties, security sources said.
They said the bomb exploded in a lemon grove some 20 metres (yards) from the two-storey centre, causing a small fire.
Syrian troops sealed off the area of the blast, the sources added.

Other security sources said gunmen in a speeding car opened fire overnight at a small van carrying three Syrian civilians, killing one and wounding another, in the Christian area of Tabarja, some 28 km (18 miles) north of Beirut.
It was not immediately known who was behind the two incidents.
Damascus is Beirut's main power broker with some 35,000 troops in Lebanon.
